clips.title: 10 men. Never beaten.
clips.caption: Solanke glances it home and the 10 men at Old Trafford have their equaliser. Nothing more than deserved.
clips.rationale: The goal followed by the players and the touchline celebrating carries the emotion of a late equaliser.
